description: Post to a channel by name or id, to coordinate: a decision and its why, a handoff, an ask. A few lines, point first. Never progress or what git already records. A name nobody wears creates that channel for this message (`createdChannel: true` comes back; say what the subject is for); a near-miss of a living name is refused with suggestions instead. Tag @handle in the body to reach someone, @everyone for the whole channel.

replyTo.description: Id of a message in this channel that this one answers
